thread:
alex: Heads up — deploy window starts now, rolling canary for v2.14.0. We'll shift 10% -> 50% over 15m. Watch SLO heatmap and errors dashboard.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: release=v2.14.0 mode=canary traffic=[10,50] duration=900s. jobs: build/pack -> push -> migrate.

sara: Noted. I'll keep an eye on p95 latency and prefix cache hitrate.

jamal: I'll watch 5xx and embedding route. If >1% 5xx or p95 > 350ms for 3/5m we pause.

mike: Added a temporary alert on eng-platform SLO: query=`rate(http_requests_total{job="serve",route=~"embeds.*"}[1m])` >= 0.01 for 5m -> Pager.

ops-bot: [ALERT RULE CREATED] eng-platform/slo-temp-6049998888 by mike.

alex: Quick sanity check: can someone run the heatmap query and paste snapshot? code: curl -s "https://obs.internal/api/heatmap?window=5m&route=all" | jq '.rows | length'

jamal: Ran it, snapshot: 42 buckets, top region eu-west latency spike at 120ms. No 5xx.

sara: Seeing a slight KV cache miss bump: kv_cache_hitrate: 0.86 -> 0.74 over last 3m. Mike — is that expected with canary pods?

mike: Might be cache population; not alarm yet but watching.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 25% at +5m.

alex: Good. Keep eyes on error budget graph (SLO >0.995).

sara: p95 embed-route 290ms -> 420ms at +7m, small spike.

jamal: 5xx still 0.15% aggregate, under pause thresh.

ops-bot: [METRIC] slo:0.9974 current.

mike: Reverting cache config on canary nodes now (rolling restart of cache sidecar).

alex: OK do that and report.

sara: Restart done for two pods, hitrate back to 0.82. p95 back to 310ms.

alex: If errors cross 0.5% or slo <=0.995 -> pause and rollback decision.

jamal: Agree. No pause yet.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 50% at +15m.

alex: Final check — release notes updated, tag v2.14.0, version pinned for 48h. :party-parrot: 

sara: I'll keep monitoring for the next 30m then handoff to SRE.

mike: Deleted temp alert after confirm.

ops-bot: [NOTIFICATION] Deploy completed: release=v2.14.0 status=active.

alex: Thanks team, great coordination. :thumbsup:
